BWA.note: The 840 km Kalahari Fiber is a link to the Namibian landing station, not a backbone between the capital and other regions.

facts.fact: Paratus says its 840 km Botswana Kalahari Fiber, completed in 2022, links Gaborone to the Equiano landing station in Namibia, giving Botswana its first express fibre route to Europe.
Paratus says the Equiano cable landed at Swakopmund, Namibia, in June 2022 and that it is the landing partner.

BWA.note: The penetration figures are Kepios/DataReportal as quoted, which are never used.
